Name: In-place Real Time
Author: Lyhsayin
Description:
Should be compatible with all ContentPatcher-based interface skin.

[b]Default configuration:[/b]

[list]
[*]Hotkey: R
[*]Display format: Same format as the one used for the in-game time
[size=1]([/size][size=1]24-hour clock and 12-hour clock format also available)[/size][/list]
[b]Tested with:[/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35996]DBB's Victorian Gothic User Interface[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface v2[/url]﻿
[/list]
Includes config translations for French, Spanish, Portugese and German.
